citation.title: Observation of resonant and non-resonant magnetic braking in the n = 1 non-axisymmetric configurations on KSTAR
citation.authors: Kim, Kimin; Choe, W.; In, Y.; Ko, W.H.; Choi, M.J.; Bak, J.G.; Kim, H.S.; Jeon, Y.M.; Kwak, J.G.; Yoon, S.W.; Oh, Y.K.; Park, J.-K.

topic: n=1 IVCC phasing and q95 effects on KSTAR magnetic braking, density pump-out, ELMs, and ideal plasma response (IPEC).
own_question: How do the -90, 0, and +90 n=1 phasings and q95 (~6 to ~7.2) determine resonant versus non-resonant braking?
actual_method_and_evidence: H-mode discharges with Ip=0.5 MA and BT=2.0-2.4 T. The paper reports time traces of rotation, ion temperature, density, and D-alpha. Analysis uses vacuum and IPEC spectra, Chirikov parameters, and overlap fields. Torque is estimated offline from the angular-momentum change over about 100 ms in inter-ELM windows. ECEI cross-coherence is compared between a large ELM and a mitigated ELM. The text does not specify the rotation or ion-temperature diagnostic or the impurity species, and it describes no nowcasting.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: The source reports that applied 3D fields in KSTAR H-modes changed rotation, density, and core ion temperature, which shows that pedestal-region Ti can evolve during applied perturbations.
claim_checks.qualification: Ion temperature is reported from time traces that were not viewed. The diagnostic and species are not stated in the text, and the evidence covers a single 2016-era campaign.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not applicable. The source has no causal estimation, no CES report timing, and no BES-to-Ti mapping. ECEI is used offline only, for ELM spectral analysis.
forbidden_inferences: That the source used CES or carbon impurity Ti (this is not stated in the text)
That the source supports any KSTAR2022 conditions or real-time capability
That observing a mechanism here validates our estimator
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most, this could serve as optional KSTAR context showing that 3D-field and ELM events perturb profiles. It does not bear on nowcasting, CES latency, or BES/ECEI information content, so it is best excluded unless a sentence on application scenarios is added.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
